event_summary: A small orange hanging ball assembly descends in front of a wall and mirror until the ball rests on the wooden tabletop.
raw_event_description: At the start, an orange spherical object with shiny metal hardware hangs from an orange cord near the upper part of the frame, above a wooden tabletop and in front of a pale wall. A mirror on the right shows its reflection. Over the sequence, the hanging assembly moves steadily downward while staying approximately vertical under the cord. A blurred dark spot on the wall also shifts lower. The orange ball reaches the tabletop, then remains in contact with the tabletop with the cord still extending upward out of frame.

reasons: The orange ball and most attached hardware are visible near the top of the frame.
The upper cord and support continue out of frame.
The wall, tabletop, and mirror are visible.
No separate stationary pre-event interval is shown before the downward motion sequence.
